name: orthogonal_pair_geometry_v23
method: Algebraic weight-space programming without training or gradients
hypothesis: The input pair embedding adds orientation-sensitive relative vectors and invariant distance and reference-space-mask features. Remove the projection of the two invariant embeddings onto the relative-vector column space. This isolates their initial affine contributions without changing relative-vector weights or learned nonlinear pair processing. It is a targeted test of vector-scalar interference, not a guarantee of rotational equivariance.
